best_idea: Armour wears per piece at the hit location (0.2 of the post-armour damage), loses value only past 75% wear on a linear ramp to half at full wear, and is repaired by a roll: every repair clears the wear, and the roll decides how much cap the repair costs.
decision_why: Keep the per-hit wear share, the 75% ramp and the cap-based repair tiers as catalogue numbers; choose the piece with a server seed; replace the donor's silent tier below 25 with a visible warning. AGPL-3.0, so clean-room only.
acceptance: Fight test: a chest piece at 90% wear shows 70% of its armour value; a repair with a 60 outcome leaves max at 80% of its old value with damage 0; both asserted on the server.
